title: Use the site navigation to move between core pages
description: This verifies that a visitor can use the global navigation to reach the main browsing destinations.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the navigation link for products
Verify the products catalog is displayed
Click the navigation link for solutions
Verify the solutions overview is displayed

title: Submit a contact inquiry and launch the email client
description: This verifies a visitor can complete the contact form with valid information and trigger the email-client handoff.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact/
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Fill in the subject field with a valid subject
Fill in the message field with a valid message
Submit the contact form
Verify a mailto handoff is initiated
Verify the contact form no longer shows validation errors

Click the link to continue browsing products
Verify the products catalog is displayed

title: Send a valid contact inquiry through the mailto form
description: This verifies that a visitor can submit the contact form with valid details and reach the email-client handoff state.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact/
Fill in the name field with Jordan Lee
Fill in the email field with jordan@example.com
Fill in the message field with a valid inquiry message
Submit the contact form
Verify a successful mailto handoff is initiated
Verify the contact form confirms the inquiry was prepared

title: Submit a contact inquiry successfully

steps.description: Navigate to /contact/
